name: Forge and Feast
description: Kitchen Range (cook several pots at once and bake), Potbelly Stove (one pot, warms a cabin), Kiln Oven (fire clay molds and pottery), Charcoal Retort and Smoker (smokes meat and fish). Copper, bronze, iron and steel tiers. Large Pots and stovepipes. Works with Rustic Cookery.
